title: Nepal Government Tenders Scraper (PPMO e-GP / Bolpatra)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "List" scrapes bolpatra.gov.np's public tender listing (latest, or filtered by keyword/category/method/entity). "Detail" fetches the full detail page (bid schedule, fee, contact, documents) for specific tender IDs/URLs.

keyword.title: Project title keyword (mode=list only)
keyword.description: Free-text keyword matched against the tender's project title. Leave blank together with the other filters below to get the 'latest' 30 published tenders instead of a filtered search.

publicEntityName.title: Public entity name (mode=list only)
publicEntityName.description: Name (or partial name) of the government office/entity running the procurement, e.g. "Kathmandu Metropolitan". Resolved automatically to bolpatra's internal entity ID via its own autocomplete (first match is used) -- if nothing matches, the search runs without this filter and a warning is logged.

maxResults.title: Max results (mode=list only)
maxResults.description: Caps how many rows are kept from this query. bolpatra.gov.np does not support reliable page-by-page pagination via plain HTTP requests (see the actor's CRAWLING_METHOD.md) -- a single query returns one page of 10-30 rows depending on which filters are set, and this only trims that page down further. Narrow your keyword/category/method/entity for a more targeted result if you need a specific subset of the 200,000+ historical notices.

tenderId.title: Tender ID or URL (mode=detail only)
tenderId.description: A single bolpatra tender's numeric tenderId (e.g. 324758), or its full detail URL. Find IDs from a 'list' mode run's tenderId/tenderUrl fields.

tenderIds.title: Tender IDs or URLs (mode=detail only)
tenderIds.description: Multiple tender IDs (or full detail URLs) to fetch full detail for in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (mode=detail only)
maxConcurrency.description: How many tender detail pages to fetch in parallel.
